thesis: Applied Materials is the broadest semicap franchise riding the AI fab build-out: record Q2 FY2026 revenue of $7.91B (+11% y/y) at ~50% gross margin, Q3 guided to $8.95B, management seeing its semiconductor equipment business growing more than 30% in calendar 2026, and full-year forecasts raised to $31.3B revenue / $11.09 EPS. The stock has re-rated to ~56x forward EPS - multiples the semicap group has never sustained - while 85% of revenue comes from Asia-Pacific with live China trade risk (including a $253M export-controls settlement just paid).
catalysts: Calendar-2026 semicap growth >30% per management - confirmation via peer reports and TSMC/Samsung capex
Two new AI-focused chipmaking systems (advanced 3D logic and memory architectures) ramping
Advanced packaging and HBM-related tool demand (DRAM leadership position)
15% dividend raise extending a nine-year streak - capital-return support
risk_factors: Valuation: ~56x forward EPS (FY26 estimate 11.09) for ~11% revenue growth - semicap has historically traded at 15-25x; the re-rating dwarfs the fundamental acceleration
Geographic concentration: Asia-Pacific 85% of six-month revenue (China, Taiwan, Korea) - maximal exposure to trade policy and regional demand shocks
Export-controls overhang: $253M settlement paid with ongoing audit/training obligations; further restrictions would bite directly
Semicap is cyclical: equipment orders swing harder than the chip cycle itself; >30% growth years are historically followed by digestion years
Sector volatility: -2.56% week amid the broader semi pullback (beta 1.35)
